title: Ember mirror
description: Your camera as a dark mirror. Each camera frame, a compute pass compares every cell of the picture with the last and sheds particle embers where an edge moved, coloured by what shed them. Bloom adds glow. Without a camera, drifting smoke sheds instead. A video feed copies each frame into a texture the scene owns, on the web and on native.
line: Move in front of the camera and your outline sheds embers.
hint: move to shed embers · without a camera, smoke shows instead
